content:
As Jack’s work with me continued, the doctors became cautiously-hopeful that I might survive but, due to the extensive damage, they insisted that I would never walk again and that my immune-system, lungs, eyes, ears and other organs would never again function properly. However, I was determined to restore my health and regain the use of my legs; so I began my own unconventional healing-program. The results were astonishing. My recover made medical history when my body regenerated nerve, bone, muscle and organ tissues, which doctors had said would be impossible. My healing was so remarkable that it was documented and studied by medical researchers and featured in periodicals and documentaries.

The natural healing-energies available to all of us were instrumental in my recovery. During the many months that I lay in Intensive Care, Jack guided me into deep, healing states of consciousness. In these healing-states, I experienced exquisite, intricately-formed geometric, molecular patterns pulsating in my mind’s eye. As my condition improved, my curiosity was piqued by the vitality of these shapes. I began to wonder whether these powerful patterns could be found in nature and, if so, whether ingesting them would promote my healing.

Jack, Dr. Moss’ lab staff, and I gathered algae, greens, herbs and mushrooms from various parts of the world to test my hypothesis. Although we utilized numerous emergent energetic technologies to evaluate the botanicals, we discovered that the Telsa-coil 200-pulse Kirlian research-camera allowed us to capture the electromagnetic imprint – or, life-force energy – of these substances on film. For the first time, it was possible to demonstrate visually that the exquisite patterns that I had experienced in my healing-states did, in fact, exist in nature. What’s more interesting is that many of the plants that emanated the greatest life-energy are the same herbs and super foods that have historically been recommended by traditional healers for their potent restorative properties. To a man whose body had been almost completely-destroyed, this was an unbelievably-exciting discovery! As my colleagues and I continued our research, we found that the ways in which these precious botanical are grown, harvested and processed has significant impact on the potency of their life-force energy. For example, organically-grown plants have much more energetic vitality than conventionally-farmed plants.

I began consuming these botanicals and super foods in a specially-blended formula that was created to support my healing; and I subsequently offered this formula to other doctors, all of whom reported profound results. In doing so, I realized that nutritional healing is not just about vitamins, minerals, phytonutrients and technology but that it is about the life-force inherent in whole, living foods, which is far more important and powerful than simple biology. Just as a robust, healthy human being possesses an ineffable vibrancy and life-energy, we share in that radiance; their life-energy becomes our life-energy. I observed that our bodies possess a miraculous ability to heal and regenerate when we receive vital nourishment to feed our cells and innate life-force. As my knowledge and understanding of healing principles grew, I became passionate about providing an opportunity for others to experience the healing benefits of super foods and other botanicals in their own lives.

As my research continued during the next 30 years, I perfected this green super food-formula; and The Hippocrates Wellness is now offering it in its LifeGive Power Powder. LifeGive Power Powder’s formula is uniquely balanced and deeply-harmonious with the body and all of its energetic and physical systems. All of its ingredients are traditional food; in other words, they are most effective when the suggested serving size is used every day. When consumed in this way, they nourish the body at the cellular level so that it can function optimally to renew and regenerate. Thus, overall life-energy (Chi) as cardiovascular systems are strengthened and revitalized. I have found that LifeGive Power Powder profoundly-enhances health and regeneration in ways that isolated, synthetic chemical supplements cannot. The reason for this is simple: Chemicals synthesized in a laboratory cannot replicate the life-spark that is naturally-present in whole foods. I believe that it is this vital life-spark that allows our bodies to absorb and integrate all of the known and yet-to-be-known beneficial constituents in living foods.

Because my research clearly demonstrates that most growing and processing techniques compromise the energetic vitality and beneficial effects of botanicals significantly, my growers and I developed many proprietary processes to enhance and protect the radiant life-energy and nutritional quality of the plants. We also built an award-winning production-facility that incorporates sustainable technologies and business-practices. For example, the entire production-facility is 100% wind-powered. Our unique facility allows us to ensure that our ingredients and formulas are processed and packaged in a manner that provides the greatest possible protection for all of the enzymes, phytonutrients, and other active constituents in super foods and botanicals. What began a research for my own healing became a lifelong quest to understand the healing properties of super foods and botanicals and the best methods to provide those substances to everyone who seeks renewed vitality. The result is nutritional products – including Hippocrates’ LifeGive Power Powder, LifeGive Women’s and Men’s Formulas, and LifeGive Vitamin C – that capture completely the numerous life-enhancing benefits that these precious foods provide.
